heroDescription:
Rooted in shipownership.
Connected to the world of maritime trade.
companyLead: Gate One LTD is a shipowning company with a focus on dry cargo and maritime activities.
companyText: At the centre of our business is an owned dry cargo vessel built in 2014. Our activities connect vessel ownership with cargo transportation, chartering and port agency.
activitiesIntro: From the vessel itself to the voyage and the port. Four connected areas of maritime activity.
service1Text: Vessel ownership is the foundation of Gate One LTD. Our owned dry cargo vessel gives the company a direct connection to the assets at the heart of maritime trade.
service2Text: Maritime transportation of dry cargo. Each shipment starts with the cargo requirements, the vessel’s suitability and the conditions of the intended voyage.
service3Text: Vessel chartering for an agreed voyage or period. Cargo, timing and commercial terms shape each individual arrangement.
service4Text: Vessel support during port calls, connecting the ship with the shore. Agency activity centres on the coordination required for arrival, the port stay and departure.
vesselIntro:
A 5,000-tonne dry cargo vessel.
Built in 2014. Owned by Gate One LTD.
outlookText: We see shipownership as a long-term commitment. Our focus is on the vessel, the people around it and the commercial relationships that give every voyage its purpose.
principle1Text: A business grounded in a real maritime asset.
principle2Text: Bringing the vessel, the cargo and the port into one conversation.
principle3Text: Looking beyond a single voyage to the relationship ahead.
fullImageNote: AI-generated imagery illustrates the vessel type. It is not a photograph or an exact representation of the company’s vessel.
